name: Chau Doc food guide
summary: Châu Đốc eats fish from the Hậu. Breakfast at Chợ Châu Đốc is bún cá with crunchy điên điển, chili, and lime, and the hall smells of mắm stacked in the open. Dinner is lẩu mắm, the fermented-fish pot, or a hot-and-sour seafood hotpot, with cá kho tộ and rice. Afternoons are palm sweets: bánh bò thốt nốt, bánh bò Chăm, and chè thốt nốt.
body: The market is the morning. Just after sunrise the hall is already moving: noodle bowls, sugarcane juice, flowers on the pavement, and stacks of fermented fish. Eat a bowl at the edge of the hall, then walk the mắm lanes before you head for the hill.

Beyond the bowls, Châu Đốc breakfasts on cơm tấm with pickled mustard greens, hủ tiếu bò viên, bún mắm, and bún suông along the Hậu landing. Bánh hỏi comes with charcoal-grilled pork, and gỏi sầu đâu is the bitter leaf salad. The Cham villages add tung lò mò, a beef sausage dried outside the houses and grilled. After dark there is chè bưởi at the head of Trưng Nữ Vương. Khô cá, khô bò, and đường thốt nốt are the gifts to carry home. Can Tho’s bánh xèo is a different delta breakfast.
specialtiesLead: Mắm, the claypot, and the hotpots are the Châu Đốc table. Market bowls, palm sweets, and the gifts to carry home follow.

sections.heading: More Chau Doc specialties
paragraphs: The morning fish bowl, the fermented-fish pot, the Cham sausage, and the palm sweets.

sections.heading: Chau Doc Market
paragraphs: Come in the morning. VnExpress on 20 Oct 2023 prints 05:30–18:00 every day. Breakfast on the Hậu landing nearby is hủ tiếu, bún mắm, or bún suông.

spots.name: Chau Doc Market
spots.caption: The hall for bún cá, mắm, and sugarcane juice.
spots.note: Noodle bowls and strong coffee at the edge of the hall, mắm in the aisles, and sugarcane juice just after sunrise. By 7:00 the hall is busy. VnExpress prints 05:30–18:00.

spots.name: The blue hall
spots.caption: The same market from the street. Flowers, fruit, and the landing are the walk.
spots.note: The same hall seen from the street, with flowers, fruit, and vegetables on the pavement and boats unloading at the landing.

spots.name: Chau Doc floating market
spots.caption: Fruit and vegetables on the water, before the town is busy.
spots.note: Several dozen boats laden with fruit and vegetables in the early morning, each with its produce hung on a long pole so buyers can see it from far off. Wake before dawn for the painted boats.

sections.heading: Can Tho, if that breakfast is the point
paragraphs: Bánh xèo is the large turmeric crepe of the Mekong, filled with pork, beansprouts, and shrimp. It is Can Tho’s breakfast, not the Châu Đốc bowl. Inside Trà Sư, the forest restaurant’s lunch adds it beside cá lóc nướng, lẩu cá linh bông điên điển, cá linh chiên giòn, and gỏi cổ hũ dừa.

seoTitle: Chau Doc food guide: market fish, mam, claypot
seoDescription: Châu Đốc food: bún cá and mắm at the market, lẩu mắm and cá kho tộ at dinner, palm-sugar sweets, and the gifts to carry home.
